meta.description: Tier 1 site crawl: plain HTTP request, free. Fetches homepage + /pricing page. Extracts vendor name and visible text. Caller escalates to Tier 2 if word_count < 200 or name unresolved. Part of M74 three-tier crawl architecture.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ vendor_website: $json.website, tier_used: 'tier1_direct', pages: [{ page_url: $json.website, title: $json.name, clean_text: $json.text, word_count: $json.word_count, page_depth: 0 }] }) }}
